caption: How to heal your knees #wellness #usahealth #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: You rub a little ginger oil into your knees before bed, and watch what happens. The ache that has lived there for years starts to loosen. Stiffness that used to greet you every morning begins to fade. Your legs feel lighter walking down the stairs. And by the second week, you stop noticing your knees at all, which is the whole point. Your knees carry you further than almost any other part of your body, and they are the last place we ever think to give warmth back. The old healers knew this long before anyone named a nerve or measured a joint. There is a full ritual to this, and the exact oil blend I use myself. It is in my book, linked in my bio.
